criteria.text: Only a same-ID check ending unknown with service-restarted permits a replacement with a fresh attempt ID and the original source and call ceiling.
Each Story row gets at most one replacement across repeated or concurrent saved reads and retries.
Recovery preserves both attempts' request IDs, receipts and known or unknown usage.
Waiting through restart recovery avoids repeated source packing while still checking the saved source before an authorized replacement.

cases.given: same-ID terminal check unknown/service-restarted; replacement passed
cases.required_observation: 2 distinct IDs, one replacement, original source/cap and both receipts/calls

cases.given: two recoveries see same restart receipt
cases.required_observation: one exclusive replacement claim and one replacement POST total

cases.given: lost POST, wrong-ID/command, generic unknown, expiry separately
owner/source/repo mismatch or deadline/interrupt before claim
cases.required_observation: no replacement ID/POST; preserve prior evidence

cases.given: same eligible confirmed restart is visited twice in one scheduler turn and over later ticks while its replacement waits; supplied source capture counter
cases.required_observation: one capture/hash for that recovery decision, no duplicate packing on the second visit or later pending ticks; one replacement claim/POST maximum, unchanged source and call ceiling

cases.given: new recovery invocation or newly authorized replacement after prior wait; local source changed
cases.required_observation: validate source for the new dispatch decision, refuse changed source before replacement allocation/POST; avoiding repeated packing never removes saved-source equality guard
